n_genes.label: n_genes

pct_mito.label: pct_mito
pct_mito.description: mitochondrial genes (MT- / mt-, human and mouse)

pct_ribo.label: pct_ribo
pct_ribo.description: ribosomal protein genes (RPS / RPL, human and mouse)

pct_hb.label: pct_hb
pct_hb.description: hemoglobin genes (HB…, excluding the HBP pseudogenes)

pct_isotype.label: pct_isotype
pct_isotype.description: isotype controls — the protein assay's own background

aggregations.label: sum
aggregations.description: Σ counts over the gene set

aggregations.label: mean
aggregations.description: Σ ÷ genes in the set (undetected count as 0)

aggregations.label: count
aggregations.description: genes in the set with a count > 0

aggregations.label: percentage
aggregations.description: 100 × Σ set ÷ the cell's total counts

widgets.label: Count matrices

require.message: Choose at least one raw-count matrix to compute over.

widgets.empty_text: No raw-count expression matrix in this project yet. Import one (or, if you have a normalized matrix only, note that QC needs raw counts).

require.message: Every selected matrix needs a gene-name column. The metrics match genes by pattern, so without names there is nothing to match against and the run cannot compute them.

widgets.empty_text: No metrics to compute. A metric is a set of genes plus how to reduce it to one number per cell — add a custom one, or pick a predefined metric, with the controls just below.

message.min_items: No metrics to compute. Add at least one row — a metric is a gene set plus how to reduce it, and a run with none produces no columns.
message.unique_by: Two metrics share a name. Each name becomes an emitted column, and the run REFUSES a duplicate (`DuplicateMetricName`) — remove one, or rename it.

message.not_in: A column named "{value}" was already put on this axis by another analysis. This run would add a second one beside it rather than replace it, so pick another name.

widgets.empty_text: Every predefined metric is already in the table.
